findings.evidence: The learner-facing profile requires complete German-first/English-second content and first-use explanations or glossary links. FR-002 through NFR-002, risks, and acceptance criteria are not consistently bilingual, while Spec Kit and programme terms remain unexplained despite the declared no-history audience.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: The target provides complete paired DE/EN content and explains technical and workflow terms on first use or links them explicitly to the glossary; the authoring receipt is then refreshed.

findings.evidence: The normative scope excludes Specify, Plan, Tasks, Code, remote writes, and downstream Spec Kit authority, but the enabled autonomous prompt requests a full MergeAndSync run without equivalent no-implementation and no-remote boundaries.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: The autonomous prompt is disabled or constrained so that it cannot exceed the documented requirements-only write scope and separate start authority; prompt and refreshed receipt agree.

findings.evidence: FR-002 requires RF-01 through RF-18 and new findings to carry owner, target, acceptance, positive and negative evidence, status, and residual gap. The additional RF-19 through RF-21 table omits explicit target, positive/negative evidence, and residual-gap fields.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: RF-19 through RF-21 satisfy every FR-002 field or FR-002 is explicitly and consistently revised; linked evidence and the target receipt are current.

findings.evidence: Public-content, authority, privacy, and accessibility boundaries are present, but platform and supply-chain applicability are neither declared applicable nor explicitly marked N/A for this documentation-only intake.
